description: Checkout attempts payment RPCs through an invalid destination address.

incident.title: Customers cannot complete checkout
incident.description: Orders fail during checkout while product browsing still works. Investigate which part of the request path is failing and why.

diagnostic_reference.observable_mechanism: The caller fails during destination name resolution, reporting zero resolved addresses. The affected owner is checkout and the failing edge is checkout to payment.
diagnostic_reference.propagation: The failed outgoing Charge propagates through PlaceOrder to checkout failure.
exclusions: Do not substitute payment application rejection for caller resolution failure.
Do not assert payment server outage, global DNS outage, or an exact bad destination absent retained evidence.
